hardware.compute_grid_note: Galaxy target grid (10 rows x 12 columns), person's instruction 2026-10-28; stage 1 was measured on the P150a's full 13 x 10. On the P150a, 12 x 10 is reached with the runtime option TT_METAL_CORE_GRID_OVERRIDE_TODEPRECATE=11,9, set by tt/config.py (EMBEDDING_GEMMA2_GRID=12x10, default of tests/perf/prefill.py) before the first device open and checked with compute_with_storage_grid_size() == (12, 10). DispatchCoreConfig axis COL is already the Blackhole default and gives (13, 10); axis ROW is rejected without fabric tensix MUX. Tracy at 1 x 2048: 0 of 646 ops above 120 cores. Evidence: doc/prefill/01-baseline/work_log.md, 'E9.1-r1: compute grid 12 x 10'.

shapes_note: seq is the physical bucket (tt/config.py SEQ_BUCKETS); 65536 is the max-cap bucket (doc/context_contract.json supported_max_seq_len). masked = a real input (tests/common.make_batch corpus, offset 0) of logical_len = 3/4 of the bucket, right-padded into the bucket, so 1/4 of the keys are padding (dense additive masks; device work does not depend on logical_len). No unmasked path exists: there is no no-mask path with an explicit caller contract.

accuracy.pcc_gate_metric: last-hidden PCC over the logical_len valid rows of the traced replay output vs HF fp32 (hard)

resolved_decisions.b1_s256: resolved 2026-10-28 (E9.1-r) without a pcc_gate_override: stage-1 failure with p3_qkv_gu (last-hidden PCC 0.98872 < 0.99 on logical 192, offset 0). The text precision was re-selected at 12 x 10 under the E6 policy with the E9 contract inputs and the b1_s256 family (offset 0, L 160-224) added to the probe; the selected p2_sdpa_fast gives 0.99438 / cosine 0.99873 on this input and passes all 10 buckets (doc/datatype_sweep/README.md, 'E9.1-r re-selection'). The E9.1-r2a default sdpa_nofp32acc gives 0.99432 / 0.99861 on it and passes all 10 buckets at 12 x 10 (same README, 'Amendment E9.1-r2a').

open_items.baseline_precision_12x10: The safe-baseline (fallback) text precision base_bfp8_hifi2 crashes at 12 x 10 in multi-bucket device sessions <= 8192 (TT_THROW: static circular buffers clash with L1 buffers, first at the 1 x 4096 full-attention SDPA). Cause (measured): its bf16 Q/K/V give a larger SDPA static CB region (ends at 1,437,056 B per core), and on 120 L1 banks the live L1-interleaved activations ([1, 1, 4096, 512] bf16: 18 tiles per bank instead of 16 on 130) plus the L1 RoPE tables start at 1,421,312 B; 13 x 10 starts at 1,445,888 B and passes; the residual stream in DRAM (EG2_RESIDUAL_L1=0) also passes. Open for E9 stage 5 (memory placement).

regime.headline: sustained
regime.sustained_definition: back-to-back replays in ~500 ms windows for max(30 s, 300 replays); median of the windows in the last third of the run; AICLK / power / current / vcore / temperature sampled every 100 ms from sysfs in a second process
regime.burst_definition: 5 windows, each after 3 s idle, of n back-to-back replays (n = 200 ms / forward, clamped to 3 ... 20); median / avg / best of the windows
